title: Several files of a film are one title; a different cut is its own title
description: Serves "Finding something to watch is easy."; "The picture is as good as the device and the connection allow."; "Their place is always one press away.".
acceptanceCriteria: Files of one film in different qualities (4K, 1080p) are one title with one watch history; playback takes the file that best suits the device and connection, and the viewer can pick another.
A different cut is its own title, with its own history, shown together with the film.
A film in several parts plays as one, in order.
Shown for films kept on local disk and on S3.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
